'''Lucas Riva Amarante "Bebê" Nogueira''' (born July 26, 1992) is a Brazilian former professional [[basketball]] player. He was selected in the first round (16th overall pick) of the [[2013 NBA draft]] by the [[Boston Celtics]], but ultimately made his NBA debut with the [[Toronto Raptors]] in 2014.

==Professional career==

===Liga ACB career===
[[File:Estudiantes vs Unicaja Málaga - Lucas Nogueira - 01.jpg|thumb|upright|Nogueira playing with Estudiantes in 2013]]
From 2009 to 2011, Nogueira played for the [[CB Estudiantes]] junior team. In 2011, he was loaned to [[CB Las Rozas]] for the 2011–12 season. In January 2012, he joined [[CB Estudiantes]] for the rest of the [[2011–12 ACB season]], and re-joined the team for the 2012–13 season as well.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=720|title=Lucas Nogueira – ACB.com|work=ACB.com|accessdate=June 30, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150326041442/http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=720|archive-date=March 26, 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On June 27, 2013, the day of the NBA draft, Nogueira signed a two-year contract extension with Estudiantes.<ref>{{cite web|title=Asefa Estudiantes extends Lucas Nogueira till 2015|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/102546/asefa-estudiantes-extends-lucas-nogueira-till-2015.html|work=Sportando.com|date=June 27, 2013|accessdate=November 11, 2013}}</ref> He went on to win the ACB's Best Defender award for the 2013–14 season.<ref>{{cite web|last=Vivlamore|first=Chris|title=Nogueira named top defender in ACB League|url=http://www.myajc.com/news/sports/basketball/nogueira-named-top-defender-in-acb-league/nfWFL/|work=myajc.com|date=April 8, 2014|accessdate=November 13, 2016}}</ref>

===NBA career===
On April 17, 2013, Nogueira officially declared for the [[2013 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/nba--brazil-s-lucas-nogueira-has-declared-for-the-nba-draft-224857819.html|title=Brazil's Lucas Nogueira declares for NBA draft|work=NBA.com|date=April 17, 2013|accessdate=April 17, 2013}}</ref> Because he had initially decided to declare for the [[2011 NBA draft]], but ultimately declined to enter it afterwards, Nogueira was not allowed to back out of the 2013 draft. He was selected with the 16th overall pick by the [[Boston Celtics]] on behalf of the [[Dallas Mavericks]], who then traded his draft rights to the [[Atlanta Hawks]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Norlander|first=Matt|title=David Stern and Lucas Nogueira's Afro provide the photo of the draft|url=http://www.cbssports.com/nba/blog/eye-on-basketball/22551535/david-stern-and-lucas-nogueiras-afro-provide-the-photo-of-the-draft|accessdate=June 27, 2013|work=CBSSports.com|date=June 27, 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Ogden|first=Maxwell|title=Atlanta Hawks Draft Lucas Nogueira After Trading for Mavericks' No. 16 Pick|url=http://bleacherreport.com/articles/1687246-hawks-reportedly-draft-lucas-nogueira-after-trading-for-mavericks-no-16-pick|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130701075249/http://bleacherreport.com/articles/1687246-hawks-reportedly-draft-lucas-nogueira-after-trading-for-mavericks-no-16-pick|url-status=dead|archive-date=July 1, 2013|accessdate=June 27, 2013|work=bleacherreport.com|publisher=Los Angeles Times|date=June 27, 2013}}</ref> In July 2013, Nogueira joined the Hawks for the [[2013 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/summerleague/2013/players/sl_lucas_nogueira/ |title=2013 Summer League Statistics |work=NBA.com |accessdate=June 30, 2014 |url-status=unfit |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20131209105246/http://www.nba.com/summerleague/2013/players/sl_lucas_nogueira/ |archivedate=December 9, 2013 }}</ref>

On June 30, 2014, Nogueira's draft rights were traded, along with [[Lou Williams]], to the [[Toronto Raptors]] in exchange for [[John Salmons]] and a 2015 second-round pick.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/trade_063014|title=Raptors Acquire Williams, Nogueira From Atlanta|work=NBA.com|date=June 30, 2014|accessdate=June 30, 2014}}</ref> In July 2014, he joined the Raptors for the [[2014 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/raptors-announce-2014-nba-summer-league-roster|title=Raptors Announce 2014 NBA Summer League Roster|work=NBA.com|date=July 7, 2014|accessdate=July 7, 2014}}</ref> On August 3, 2014, he signed with the Raptors.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-lucas-nogueira-and-will-cherry|title=Raptors Sign Lucas Nogueira And Will Cherry|work=NBA.com|date=August 3, 2014|accessdate=August 3, 2014}}</ref> On November 21, 2014, he made his NBA debut against the [[Milwaukee Bucks]]. In eight minutes of action, he recorded two points, five rebounds and one steal in a 124–83 win.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20141121/MILTOR/gameinfo.html|title=Williams scores 22 as Raptors beat Bucks 124-82|work=NBA.com|date=November 22, 2014|accessdate=November 22, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160317062601/http://www.nba.com/games/20141121/MILTOR/gameinfo.html|archive-date=March 17, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> On March 12, 2015, he was assigned to the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]] of the [[NBA Development League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/press-releases/nogueira_031215|title=Raptors Assign Nogueira To Mad Ants|work=NBA.com|date=March 12, 2015|accessdate=March 12, 2015}}</ref> He was recalled by the Raptors on March 26, 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/raptors-recall-noguiera-mad-ants|title=Raptors Recall Nogueira From Mad Ants|work=NBA.com|date=March 26, 2015|accessdate=March 26, 2015}}</ref>

In July 2015, Nogueira re-joined the Raptors for the [[2015 NBA Summer League]]. On September 29, 2015, the Raptors exercised their third-year team option on Nogueira's rookie scale contract, extending the contract through the 2016–17 season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/press-releases/caboclo-nogueira-093015/|title=Raptors Exercise Team Options On Caboclo & Nogueria|work=NBA.com|date=September 29, 2015|accessdate=September 29, 2015}}</ref> On December 5, 2015, he scored a career-high 14 points in a 112–109 loss to the [[Golden State Warriors]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20151205/GSWTOR/gameinfo.html|title=Curry scores 44 as perfect Warriors beat Raptors 112-109|work=NBA.com|date=December 5, 2015|accessdate=November 10, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=O'Leary|first=Chris|url=https://www.thestar.com/sports/raptors/2015/12/06/raptors-lucas-nogueira-trying-to-make-the-most-of-the-moment.html|title=Raptors' Lucas Nogueira trying to make the most of the moment|work=TheStar.com|date=December 6, 2015|accessdate=November 10, 2016}}</ref> During the 2015–16 season, he had multiple assignments with [[Raptors 905]] of the NBA Development League.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://dleague.nba.com/all-time-nba-assignments/|title=All-Time NBA Assignments|work=NBA.com|accessdate=November 10, 2016|archive-date=March 22, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170322122733/http://dleague.nba.com/all-time-nba-assignments/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On October 23, 2016, the Raptors exercised their fourth-year team option on Nogueira's rookie scale contract, extending the contract through the 2017–18 season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/press-releases/roster-102316/|title=Raptors Exercise Team Options On Caboclo, Nogueira & Wright|work=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2016|accessdate=November 10, 2016}}</ref> On November 9, 2016, he scored 10 points on 5-for-5 shooting and had seven rebounds in a 112–102 win over the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400899562|title=DeRozan scores 37, leads Raptors past Thunder 112-102|work=ESPN.com|date=November 9, 2016|access-date=November 10, 2016}}</ref> Three days later, he recorded six points, 10 rebounds, one assist, three steals and a career-high five blocked shots in a 118–107 win over the [[New York Knicks]].<ref>{{cite web|last=MacKenzie|first=Holly|url=http://www.nba.com/raptors/gamerap-111216|title=Game Rap: Raptors 118, Knicks 107|work=NBA.com|date=November 12, 2016|accessdate=November 13, 2016}}</ref>

On October 30, 2017, Nogueira scored a career-high 17 points in a 99–85 win over the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400974850|title=DeRozan has 25 and Toronto downs Portland 99-85|work=ESPN.com|date=October 30, 2017|access-date=October 30, 2017}}</ref>

The Raptors did not extend a qualifying offer for the 2018–19 season, so Nogueira became an [[NBA salary cap#Unrestricted free agent|unrestricted free agent]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Fleguel |first1=Jordan |title=Should the Raptors still look to resign Lucas Nogueira?|url=https://raptorsrapture.com/2018/07/03/should-the-raptors-resign-lucas-nogueira/ |accessdate=July 20, 2018 |work=Raptors Rapture |publisher=[[FanSided]] |date=July 3, 2018}}</ref>

===Later career and retirement===
On September 19, 2018, Nogueira signed with [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Montakit Fuenlabrada]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Fuenlabrada signs Lucas Nogueira |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/spain/acb/289077/fuenlabrada-signs-lucas-nogueira.html |website=Sportando |accessdate=September 19, 2018 |archive-date=September 19, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180919211304/https://sportando.basketball/en/spain/acb/289077/fuenlabrada-signs-lucas-nogueira.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In early 2020, he joined [[Al-Muharraq SC|Al-Muharraq]] of the [[Bahraini Premier League (basketball)|Bahraini Premier League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.asia-basket.com/Bahrain/news/618957/Muharraq-signs-Lucas-Nogueira|title=Muharraq signs Lucas Nogueira|date=February 18, 2020|first=Ahmad|last=Madwar|work=Asia Basket}}</ref>

In October 2020, he joined [[Associação de Basquete Cearense|Cearense]] of the [[Novo Basquete Brasil]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.latinbasket.com/Brazil/news/649930/Cearense-signs-Lucas-Nogueira|title=Cearense signs Lucas Nogueira|date=October 23, 2020|first=Paulo|last=Freire|work=Latin Basket}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/ce/basquete/nbb/noticia/fortaleza-basquete-cearense-acerta-contratacao-de-lucas-bebe-ex-nba.ghtml|trans-title=Fortaleza Basketball Cearense announces the hiring of Lucas Bebé, ex-NBA|first=Lucas|last=Catrib|language=pt|date=October 2, 2020|work=[[Rede Globo|Globo]]|title=Fortaleza Basquete Cearense anuncia a contratação de Lucas Bebê, ex-NBA}}</ref> However, on February 3, 2021, Nogueira announced his early retirement from basketball on [[Instagram]] after confirming an injury he had combined with earlier injuries during his career forcing his decision there.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/basquete/noticia/lucas-bebe-anuncia-aposentadoria-do-basquete-chegou-a-hora-de-parar.ghtml|title=Lucas Bebê anuncia aposentadoria do basquete: "Chegou a hora de parar"|language=pt|trans-title=Lucas Bebê announces retirement from basketball: "It's time to stop"|date=February 3, 2021|work=Globe Esporte}}</ref>

On August 21, 2021, Nogueira returned from retirement when he signed with [[São Paulo FC (basketball)|São Paulo FC]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Lucas Bebê é o novo reforço do Basquete Tricolor - SPFC |url=http://www.saopaulofc.net/noticias/noticias/basquete/2021/8/20/lucas-bebe-e-o-novo-reforco-do-basquete-tricolor |access-date=20 August 2021 |work=www.saopaulofc.net}}</ref>

In 2022 Nogueira signed a contract to play in [[Canada]] with the [[Guelph Nighthawks]] of the [[CEBL]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.tsn.ca/guelph-nighthawks-cebl-sign-lucas-bebe-nogueira-toronto-raptors-1.1818205 | title=CEBL's Nighthawks sign ex-Raps FW Bebe|work=[[The Sports Network|TSN]]| date=June 27, 2022 }}</ref>

==National team career==
Nogueira played for the Brazilian U-19 national team at the [[2011 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]]. He was fifth in rebounds per game and second in blocks per game. He is also a member of the senior [[Brazilian national basketball team]].

==Personal life==
He married Caroline Kuczynski in Toronto on June 26, 2016, and separated on September 20, 2016. Later that same year, their daughter Stella was born. He filed for divorce on April 17, 2018.<ref>{{cite CanLII|litigants    = Nogueira v. Kuczynski|lin =|year = 2019|court = onsc|num = 1032|format=|pinpoint= para. 5|parallelcite =|date= February 12, 2019|courtname= auto|juris=}}</ref>

He holds a [[Spanish passport]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Lucas-Nogueira-5957/|title=DraftExpress - Lucas Nogueira DraftExpress Profile: Stats, Comparisons, and Outlook|website=DraftExpress|language=en|access-date=May 13, 2018|archive-date=January 14, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180114153642/http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Lucas-Nogueira-5957/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
